name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 孫悟空(身勝手の極意)
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Son Goku (The Secret of Selfishness)

ja: 孫悟空最強の姿「身勝手の極意」をFigure-rise Standardで立体化！
• はだけた上半身の他、破れた道着がなびく腰帯、銀色の髪など、「身勝手の極意」の特徴的なポイントを再現。
• 露になった筋骨隆々な上半身の肉体を再現。
• 表情パーツは「通常」と、最終決戦で見せた「食いしばり」の２種が付属。
• 特徴的な瞳は、こだわりの成形色と形状でリアルに再現。
en: Son Goku's strongest form, "The Secret of Selfishness", is made into three-dimensional form with Figure-rise Standard!
• In addition to the exposed upper body, the characteristic points of "Seishashi no Gokui" are reproduced, such as the flowing waistband of the torn gi and silver hair.
• Reproduce the exposed muscular upper body.
• Two types of expression parts are included: "normal " and " clenching" as shown in the final battle.
• The characteristic eyes are realistically reproduced with carefully selected molding colors and shapes.

ja: 表情パーツ3種（通常、食いしばり）×各1
手首パーツ4種（左右握り手、左右かめかめ波手）×各1
必殺技エフェクト2種（かめはめ波溜め、かめはめ波放出）×各1
en: 3 types of facial expression parts (normal, clenching) x 1 each
4 types of wrist parts (left and right grip hands, left and right kamekame wave hands) x 1 each
2 types of special move effects (Kamehameha reservoir, Kamehameha release) x 1 each
